semiconductor_relevance: High — CIQTEK specializes in advanced electron microscopy and nanotechnology tools critical for semiconductor research and development.
summary: CIQTEK Co., Ltd. provides high-end electron microscopy solutions, including FIB/SEM and TEM, tailored for semiconductor technology and materials science. Their products enable precise nanoanalysis and fabrication, empowering customers to enhance innovation and productivity in semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.China: CIQTEK operates 12 R&D centers across China, focusing on advanced instrumentation development.
